description: Defines the CodecProperties class for managing codec configuration, mappings, features, and tuning parameters within the Android mediaformatshaper namespace.

classes.name: CodecProperties
classes.description: Manages codec configuration, mappings, features, and tuning parameters, including support for quality rules, resolution-based parameters, and registration status.

methods.name: CodecProperties
methods.description: Constructor initializing codec with name and media type.

methods.name: Seed
methods.description: Seeds the codec with preconfigured default values.

methods.name: setMapping
methods.description: Establishes a mapping from standard key to non-standard value within a specified kind.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Translates a standard key to a non-standard key, returning the original if no mapping exists.

methods.name: getMappings
methods.description: Returns an array of paired 'from' and 'to' values for mappings, with direction specified by 'reverse'.

methods.name: setSupportedMinimumQuality
methods.description: Sets the minimum quality rule support level.

methods.name: supportedMinimumQuality
methods.description: Returns the supported minimum quality level.

methods.name: targetQpMax
methods.description: Calculates target QP max based on resolution.

methods.name: setSupportsQp
methods.description: Sets whether QP bounding is supported.

methods.name: supportsQp
methods.description: Returns whether QP bounding is supported.

methods.name: getMissingQpBoost
methods.description: Returns the boost amount when QP is requested but unsupported.

methods.name: setMissingQpBoost
methods.description: Sets the boost amount for unsupported QP requests.
